learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with tools for image processing using classical and advanced techniques.
Generalize the use of processing tools to images that are not necessarily remote sensing (e.g., biomedical images), discussing their most important characteristics and differences.
Further develop the ability to work as a team.
Develop the ability to make efficient presentations.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the use of satellite data (main characteristics, differences between radar and optical data based on acquisition sensors)
Processing techniques and tools for satellite data
Introduction to Google Earth Engine (GEE) as an online satellite data catalogue
Basic codes (e.g., Java script) to access and filter raster and vector data from GEE data catalogue
Ways to view and download processed products from GEE
Outline of the use of Python for image processing
Application cases of interest in Remote Sensing
Generalization of processing tools for images that are not necessarily remote sensing (e.g., biomedical images), discussing their characteristics and differences
Preliminary concepts of Machine Learning and Deep Learning
Application of Machine Learning and Deep Learning to image processing
teaching_methods: Distribution of scientific articles for Case Studies
Support from course tutors and technology tutors
Student interventions (e.g., presentations of specific activities)

assessment_methods.method: Reports (final and during the course) summarizing activities on assigned case studies

assessment_rules: The final grade is based on the assessment of the work done in preparing reports and the ability to present it orally. Report development and application activities will be discussed in class but carried out by students individually or in groups of up to three people outside of class.
bibliography: M. P. Del Rosso, A. Sebastianelli, and S. L. Artificial Intelligence Applied to Satellite-Based Remote Sensing Data for Earth Observation, Institution of Engineering and Technology, 2021.
S. Lobachev, K. H. Maier-Hein, and L. Maier-Hein (eds.), Deep Learning for Medical Image Analysis, Academic Press, 2023.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica E Biomedica (Electronics And Biomedical Engineering), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
